2607.24399.title: Multivariate Time Series Forecasting with Adaptive Non-Local Observables
2607.24399.paper_summary: Multivariate time series forecasting (MTSF) predicts future values of multiple variables from historical data. While quantum neural networks have been increasingly applied to this task, they typically rely on fixed local measurements, which restrict their expressivity. We propose MTSF-ANO, a simple hybrid model for MTSF that integrates variational quantum circuits with adaptive non-local observables (ANO). On the four ETT datasets, MTSF-ANO ranks first or second in MSE in 17 of 20 settings, improving over the strongest baseline by up to 20% on ETTh1, and outperforms or matches its fixed local observable counterpart across all settings. Our ablations show how the quantum circuit design and ANO non-locality affect performance. These results suggest that ANO is a promising direction for quantum time series forecasting.
2607.24399.paper_summary_zh: 多變量時間序列預測（MTSF）從歷史數據中預測多個變量的未來值。雖然量子神經網絡在這項任務中被越來越多地應用，但它們通常依賴於固定的局部測量，這限制了它們的表達能力。我們提出了MTSF-ANO，一種簡單的混合模型，用於MTSF，將變分量子電路與自適應非局部觀測量（ANO）結合。在四個ETT數據集上，MTSF-ANO在20個設置中的17個中在均方誤差（MSE）上排名第一或第二，並在ETTh1上比最強基準提高了多達20％，在所有設置中均優於或與其固定局部觀測量對應物相匹配。我們的消融實驗顯示了量子電路設計和ANO非局部性如何影響性能。這些結果表明，ANO是量子時間序列預測的一個有前景的方向。
